notes: ABox revision, stored edit on in_class (functional): the dolphin is a cartilaginous fish. The subject is the dolphin as a kind, treated as one individual of the ontology, which is why Flipper inherits the class. Related: 'Are dolphins marine mammals?' (yes before, no after; inheritance through the stored rule that every marine mammal is a mammal). Derived: two compositions (same class as the great white shark; same class as the stingray) and an inheritance question (Flipper, a dolphin). Determinate queries ask about a class or an individual member, never about a trait of dolphins that models store by name (skeleton, breathing, nursing), because those split by storage. The one indeterminate query asks whether the dolphin breathes with gills (background beliefs): stored about dolphins by name they breathe air with lungs, stored through the class they would breathe with gills. Known weakness: derived[0] and derived[1] have the same shape.
